validation: ARM64 glibc host; not Android device validation

baseline_observations: Unaccelerated static worker exec and exited-leader exec terminated with SIGSEGV although the launcher returned zero.
Accelerated dynamic fork-worker inherited an internal O_PATH FD: available child FD capacity 12 instead of 13.

final_matrix.assertions: Actual guest PASS lines and clean launcher exit required; launcher exit alone is insufficient.

faststat-test passed native and emulated link metadata, fork/thread fallback and exec.
Seven existing single-check guard cases passed, including raw CLONE_FILES with high syscall-number bits and high-bit seccomp/io_uring calls.
limitations: No Android lifecycle, device kernel or APK execution-policy claim follows from these host tests.
